verdict.rationale: Live mode's WebSocket stream returns two distinct result types: Captions (partial results) and completed transcript items. Captions are described as arriving before a Live transcript item completes, which gives a basic interim-versus-final distinction. The partial-results feature is in preview, and the documented finality semantics are thin. Missing for 10: detailed finality semantics (whether captions are revised or replaced, and the event or field schema marking finality), general availability of the partial-results feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, streaming results distinguish interim from final transcripts, with the finality semantics documented

citations.quote: Stream audio over WebSocket and receive Captions (partial results) and completed transcript items as speech is detected and processed.
Provides Captions (partial transcription results) before a Live transcript item completes (Partial results feature in preview)
